title: Xerca's Building Blocks
description: Decorative and functional blocks including carved wood variants, terracotta tiles, rope, bookcase, straw and leather blocks
body:
This mod various blocks to expand your block pallette, as well as some with functionality.

Carved Wood

Craft a Carving Bench and carve all kinds of logs into 8 unique variants each with a different cultural style! The patterns are interconnecting vertically and horizontally, so go ham with expressing your creativity in building.

Carving Bench recipe:

Nether carved stems each have a special effect. Carved Crimson Stems glow in the dark with a waving animation and Carved Warped Stems move eerily.

Terracotta Tiles

Good for roofing, flooring, and anywhere else you may want terracotta colored tiling. Use a Stonecutter to cut Terracotta blocks into Terracotta Tiles. 

Rope

Rope is both a decorative and functional block that connects to itself and any other block that has a face it can connect to. You can climb the rope and use it to pull blocks with sticky pistons.

Bookcase

Bookcase is the Bookshelf's functional brother. It was more special before Chiseled Bookshelf was a thing, but it is still useful because it has the same look as Bookshelf when it is full. It can only store books and bookish items. It works with Redstone Comparators to give off a signal based on fullness.

Leather & Straw Blocks

These are simple blocks you can use to store leather and sugar canes more efficiently, and as building materials. Straw works as a tatami style texture as well.

Note

In older versions, this mod used to be a part of XercaMod before it was split.
